title: One Step Commutes with Silent Machine Embedding
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota:\mathrm{Fin}(m)\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Fin}(k)$, and choose a tape index $\mathrm{cap}$. For any $m$-tape machine $M$, any initial configuration $c$, any $k$-tape contents and head positions, and any words $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{out}_0$, one step of the silently embedded machine from the embedded configuration equals the embedding of the configuration obtained by one step of $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: natural tape counts and embedding of tape indices
arbitrary machine, tape contents, head positions, words, and initial configuration
